rationale: Apart from the degenerate zero-scale case, the blind translation closely preserves the source's binders, hypotheses, quantifier order, two-sided event, exact prefactor, absolute constant placement, and distinct sum-of-squares and maximum normalizations. The source itself leaves both denominators undefined when all sub-exponential norms vanish, whereas the translation selects totalized real division. Because the protocol forbids inferring missing source semantics, both implication directions remain unclear and adjudication is required.
